question: What happens when a Basic-plan subscriber with no card on file passes the 10240MB a month bandwidth allowance of the Bandwidth Platform Fee (USD 0.001 per 1MB): the calls stop, a balance accrues, or a charge is attempted?
why: Rapid's docs say the bandwidth platform fee is charged to the consumer on every subscription; the behaviour past the allowance with no payment method on file is not stated. It needs a signed-in account with usage above the allowance: behind a sign-up.
